   ▶ 1. Switch to Never Ask and start
        Best if you want Kimi Code to keep working while you are away. Tools
        are approved automatically and questions are skipped; only plans in
        Plan mode wait for your review.
     2. Switch to Ask When Needed and start
        Tools are approved automatically. Kimi Code may still ask you
        questions.
     3. Start in Always Ask
        Keep approvals on. Kimi Code will ask before risky actions, so the goal
        may stop and wait for you.
     4. Do not start
        Return to the input box with your goal command.
